svg.title: The Orchard content lifecycle
svg.desc: Discovery, currency inspection, and a designed request-intake path all feed one shared queue and one Gate 1 owner approval. Approved work moves through a research, authoring, and review ensemble to a second Gate 2 approval bound to the exact artifact digest, then commit, push, and a designed live-verification step. A Gate 2 denial returns the work for rework with a reason.
